reviews.comment: Excellent professor. Gives a VERY large amount of extra credit, so if you are willing to do the work, you will get an excellent grade in the class. Very engaging in his lectures, really enjoyed every day of his class. Mandatory attendance, however this isn't bad as usually his lectures aren't before noon.

He is an amazing professor who cares deeply about his students and their ambitions. I spent 10 straight days with him since he was my professor for my study abroad program. He's not scared of questions, is incredibly curious, and is just a great guy.

Brenner definitely has a lot of quirks, but I liked him and he was very helpful in providing resources to improve your German outside of class. Even if you pay attention to his lectures it's likely you'll be lost 90% of the time so just be prepared. Easy class but my German didn't really get any better. Beware his grading system is funky too

Dr. Brenner was pretty alright, but I will say that I lost German skills throughout the semester as opposed to improving. He didn't really teach and I honestly couldn't tell you what we did in class. We covered some concepts from 101 but that was about it. Lots of partner work and not a lot of graded homework. He was very funny. Very dad like.

Brenner is my absolute favorite prof at A&M, he does teeter on the line of socially correctness but he is absolutely hilarious. German is a tough language to learn but he makes it easy by giving ample opportunities to practice and gives great resources. the class is hard but only if you don't actually want to learn the language.

Neurotic is definitely the word I'd use to describe him, but I don't understand how you can fall asleep in his class. It's either you pay attention or you have no idea what's going on but in a good way.

I have no idea why some people don't like Dr. Brenner. He is INCREDIBLY hilarious, and he makes his lectures entertaining, which makes learning fun and engaging. I've learned so much from listening to him ramble compared to trying to learn from Duolingo or a textbook. He rubs some people the wrong way, but my friends and I loved him as our prof

Prof. Brenner made the class interesting. Lots of homework but necessary to learn a foreign language. The TA sessions were helpful. He gives a ton of extra credit. Attendance mandatory. You have one major project. I enjoyed the class and would take again.

Dr. Brenner utilizes the teach yourself method. In class he prioritized extra credit. My classmates and I taught ourselves through the load of homework assigned each day and depended on the TA to teach. If you struggle, focus on extra credit. He doesn't make it difficult to pass & as long as you show progress between tests, your grade will improve.

This class can be tough and time-consuming, but it has to be that way if you expect to learn anything of substance in one semester. You will make mistakes if you are new to German, but it will be okay. Try to set aside time for class daily. Dr. Brenner considers your previous experience when grading, so the most important thing to do is try.

I took him at the University of St.Thomas. He an amazing person and professor. He is very caring, clear, and hard working. He is flexible and great at communicating. He is a very interesting and fun professor. Would recommend him and take him again. WARNING his sense of humor is a bit triggering but he means well and it's mostly all jokes.

I love Dr. Brenner! He is funny and keeps lectures interesting. He might not be the best professor if you are completely new to German, but if you already have some understanding of the language then he is awesome.

When it comes to language classes, Dr. Brenner is a bit unconventional. He applies a "progress factor" to your grade,boosting your grade when you improve. Brenner does not let you know your real grade on Canvas, so you have to ask him to calculate it for you. He is very funny and cultivates a great learning enviroment!

Lectures were interesting, detailed, gave lots of good info for essays. This class is almost all writing based but very doable. The directions were always extremely clear and he was a fair grader, gave opportunities to submit corrections, lots of extra credit opportunities, and gave really great feedback. Definitely take him if you can!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Brenner is knowledgeable and informed about his subject, does not have times where things are not getting done in class, and the class is structured in a coherent and progressivly more difficult manner.

Dr. Brenner is such a great professor. He is very easy going and I feel like everything we learned was very aplicable. He told lots of jokes and made class very entertaining. Would 100 percent recommend him

Professor Brenner is highly underrated. I had him once precovid and then a couple more times during COVID and online school isn't easy for anyone to teach or learn. But he still makes learning fun with odd humor and tangents. Teaching style isnt "normal" but he honestly helped me stay engaged. He is good with all German classes as well. I recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Brenner, while charming, is not a professor that is up to A&M standards. He does not understand that most students do not live and breathe German and that some students cannot simply teach themselves. He does not teach his students -- Duolingo and the text book will be your teacher, not Dr. Brenner.

Dr. Brenner is a caring, funny professor. I attended online 4x/week and in person once a week. In class we would just sit on zoom so there was no point in going in person. There's hw everyday but it's not hard, just time consuming. He gives lots of extra credit and will make sure you get a good grade if you're putting in effort.
He's a hilarious guy who is also caring and willing to accommodate for his students. I had a lot of fun in his class

Dr. Brenner is funny but he believes in college you should teach yourself and he is mostly their to facilitate that teaching. Foreign language classes are going to be somewhat difficult and labor intensive, but he is not a bad prof. He is also willing to work with you and will go above and beyond for his students. Also his humor is dry & sarcastic!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Doctor Brenner was an awesome professor whose teaching methods are not what some students may be "used to," but I can definitely say that they worked. He has a great personality and genuinely loves teaching and the German language and culture. He's a very approachable guy. Don't listen to some students' complaints about him -- he's really cool!

I had no prior experience, but I learned a lot over the semester. Yes, mainly due to the HW assignments, but if you really want to learn, then PRACTICE. You can only practice so much during class; participate in it. I also saw the TA as often as possible (this helped most). If you truly want to learn, you will. You'd be surprised on your progress.

Professor Brenner is a good Professor. His persona is quite unique and he will keep your attention. There is only so much German one can learn in three fifty minute lectures a week, so there is quite a bit of homework. The homework helps a lot on the quizzes and exams. This class is quite easy as long as you put in a basic amount of effort.

If you do ALL of the online hw on time, you're guaranteed an A but get ready to teach yourself 100% of the material. Going to class is a complete waste of time, but it's mandatory. He doesn't allow you to use any electronic device (even for the textbook or translator) and will call you out if you do. Take a different language if you still can.

Do NOT take this class. You can get by with an easy A/B, but I solely relied on the HOURS of homework and the TA to teach me German. In class he skims through the slides for 3 mins and then does other things completely unrelated to the material. I came into this class eager to learn German, but was highly disappointed.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Brenner is not a good teacher. He is often sarcastic which is usually offensive. There are 5 hard tests and optional final and 20-40 online homework assignments every day. If you want to learn German, do not take his class. There are a lot of opportunities for extra credit but it is not worth it because you do not learn any German. Not an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Professor Brenner is just a good teacher. The only way you'll learn is if you go to the TA and do your homework. Not a very nice guy either but definitely an easy A.

If you want to learn german. Good luck. If you take this course you are going to learn everything from the book and the homework which comes from the book. Homework is a participation grade so if you just do it you get the a and the quizzes are not difficult if you did the homework.

Brenner is extremely enthusiastic about teaching German, but his lectures are erratic at best, and he spends twenty minutes of each 50-minute period making us take a five question quiz. If you don't teach yourself on your own, you will never learn German, but the class is definitely an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Brenner is overall a good guy and clearly enthusiastic about German. There are a lot of tests and quizzes but he provides good options for extra credit. As a Germ 101/102 professor he was only okay, but he would probably be better suited for an upper level german class.

Brenner is a great guy, funny, dry humor, always comes with energy and something to poke fun at and sometimes a little to far. He is a great guy absolutely horrendous professor and fun class  I earned an A in the class. But I honestly believe that he messed up the grading. I learned absolutely nothing and failed almost every single online homework.

Not gonna suger coat it. If you REALLY want to learn German and he is the only option you have, go to a different school!  I had an A in the class and learned ABSOLUTELY nothing!  I dropped it because it was an absolute waste of my time! My proficency dropped so much in his class that I could barely say hello (hallo)!  Not a bad guy, just bad prof.

Don't expect to actually learn German in class, the only real way of succeeding is to do all the online hw and just show up to class for the daily quiz. This means that you're essentially teaching yourself German but you'll get a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY
